item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Schuylkill Haven Tops Blue Mountain in Schuylkill League Matchup
item.description: In a key early-season Schuylkill League Division 1 showdown, Schuylkill Haven used a strong second half to secure a 47-38 victory over visiting Blue Mountain on Tuesday night. Both teams entered the matchup with identical 1-0 league records, and the competitive first half reflected that. item.title: North Schuylkill Swears In Newly Elected School Board Members During Annual Reorganization Meeting
item.description: North Schuylkill School District welcomed both new and returning members to its Board of Directors on Wednesday evening, holding its annual reorganization meeting ahead of the regular monthly session. Five members — Jennifer Kowalonek, Michael A. Kehler, Randy Lattis, Alexandra Trexler, and Bryan Slotcavage — were officially sworn in by Schuylkill County Judge, the Honorable Christina E. Hale.
